value.rationale: Exactly five goods is the first unresolved two-agent adjacent-swap case after the motivating four-good theorem, hence a motivated sharp finite cutoff. The all-start acyclicity, exact 18 move global bound and exact 6 move truthful-start bound provide genuinely useful constraints/benchmarks for attempts at the open all-size convergence conjecture; not a routine normalization or an unmotivated slice.
